units.title: Windows and alpha blending, one test program
units.detail: WIN0/WIN1/OBJ window and BLDCNT/BLDALPHA/BLDY in runtime/src/ppu.rs compose. One agb program from the template covers both; its frame must match mGBA (just mgba-diff) and first-frame. Once just unit lands, record it as a units/*.env.

record.evidence: Windows (WIN0/WIN1/OBJ window) and BLDCNT/BLDALPHA/BLDY effects in runtime ppu compose (ppu/window.rs, ppu/blend.rs). agb/windows-blend matches mGBA and first-frame at frame 10 (hash e627b66bddd453a5); just unit windows-blend passes (99.8% compiled); just check passes.

notes.text: mGBA 0.10.5 brightens sprites that aren't a first target when the OBJ window is on; the ROM makes sprites a first target to avoid it (memory/mgba-blend-quirks.md). Semi-transparent sprites blend even where the window turns effects off, as mGBA does.

units.title: Affine backgrounds and affine sprites
units.detail: Rotation/scaling for BG2/BG3 (modes 1 and 2) and affine OBJs (double size). One agb test program; frame matches mGBA and recompiled matches interpreted.

record.evidence: agb/affine (mode 2: rotated BG2, wrapping scaled BG3, four affine sprites incl. double size, shear, 90-degree wrap) matches mGBA 0.10.5 at frame 10 (hash ec6ab5fd2f3454cf); just unit affine passes: recompiled = interpreted, 99.6% compiled; 26 SCENE.md pixels hand-derived and checked; just check passes. Mode 1 BG2 covered by runtime unit tests.

notes.text: Reference points reload when BGxX/BGxY's value changes (bg_affine::Refs); rewriting the same value mid-frame isn't seen. Runners render at V-blank, so the test ROM is mode 2 only; mode 1's BG2 is checked by runtime unit tests.

units.title: Affine transform for the bitmap modes 3-5
units.detail: BG2 in modes 3-5 is drawn untransformed; hardware samples it through BG2's matrix and reference point (out of bounds transparent, no wrap). bg_affine::Refs already tracks the points. One agb test program; frame matches mGBA.

record.evidence: BG2 in modes 3-5 samples through its matrix and Refs' reference point, out of bounds transparent, wrap ignored (unit tests for each mode). New agb/bitmap-affine (mode 5 page 1, 30 deg, 1.25x): just unit bitmap-affine passes, hash 295be5b30dc6be77, mGBA matches; all 38400 pixels equal SCENE.md's formula by script. just check passes; jsmolka-arm unit still passes.

units.title: Mosaic, and modes 1 and 2 end to end
units.detail: MOSAIC for backgrounds and sprites, and modes 1/2 mixing regular and affine backgrounds. One agb test program; matches mGBA and first-frame.

record.evidence: Mosaic for text, affine and bitmap BGs and regular/affine sprites (runtime ppu/mosaic.rs, 6 unit tests). New agb/mosaic-modes (mode 1: text BG0 in mosaic, text BG1, affine BG2 in mosaic, 5 sprites, 3 in mosaic): just unit mosaic-modes passes, hash 6766e80e49684d00, mGBA 0.10.5 matches, recompiled = interpreted, 99.9% compiled; 20 SCENE.md pixels hand-derived and checked. Mode 2 stays covered by agb/affine. just check passes; affine, bitmap-affine, windows-blend, gba-cart1 units still pass.

notes.text: Mosaic follows mGBA 0.10.5: a regular sprite's last mosaic block runs past its right edge; an affine sprite's block starting left of its box draws nothing; affine BG mosaic steps the ref point back by PB/PD. Test ROM avoids mGBA's affine out-of-bounds block quirk (BG2 wraps).
